title: Arithmetic operation failed
description: Base class for arithmetic failures.
solution: Validate operands and handle the specific arithmetic exception.

title: Assertion failed
description: An assert statement evaluated to false.
solution: Check the assumption and make the assertion condition true, or raise a clearer validation error.

title: Attribute does not exist
description: Code accessed an attribute that the object does not provide.
solution: Check the object type, spelling, and initialization before accessing the attribute.

title: Unexpected end of input
description: Input was requested but no more data was available.
solution: Handle end-of-file explicitly and provide input when running non-interactively.

title: File was not found
description: The requested path does not exist from the current working directory.
solution: Verify the path, working directory, and file existence before opening it.

title: Import failed
description: Python could not import the requested name from a module.
solution: Check the exported name, import path, and circular-import dependencies.

title: Invalid indentation
description: The indentation structure is not valid Python.
solution: Use consistent spaces and indent every block under its colon.

title: Sequence index is out of range
description: A list, tuple, or string was accessed at an unavailable position.
solution: Check the sequence length or iterate over its valid elements.

title: Dictionary key is missing
description: A dictionary lookup requested a key that is not present.
solution: Use dict.get(), check membership, or initialize the key first.

title: Insufficient memory
description: The process could not allocate enough memory for an operation.
solution: Process data in chunks, reduce object sizes, or use streaming instead of loading everything.

title: Module is not installed
description: Python cannot find the requested module in the active environment.
solution: Install the package in the selected environment or correct the module name.

title: Undefined name
description: The code uses a variable or function before defining or importing it.
solution: Define the name first, or import it from the module that owns it.

title: Feature is not implemented
description: A method or placeholder deliberately indicates missing behavior.
solution: Implement the method or call a concrete subclass that provides it.

title: Operating-system operation failed
description: A system-level file, process, or device operation failed.
solution: Check the path, permissions, resource state, and platform-specific constraints.

title: Numeric result overflowed
description: A numeric operation produced a value outside the supported range.
solution: Use bounded inputs, a wider numeric strategy, or handle overflow explicitly.

title: Permission denied
description: The process does not have permission to access the resource.
solution: Use an accessible path and verify file or directory permissions.

title: Recursion limit reached
description: Recursive calls did not reach a base case before the limit.
solution: Add or correct the base case, or replace deep recursion with iteration.

title: Dead weak reference
description: A weak reference points to an object that has been garbage collected.
solution: Check the reference for None and keep a strong reference when the object must remain alive.

title: Runtime operation failed
description: The operation is invalid for the current runtime state.
solution: Inspect the full traceback and validate the state before the operation.

title: Invalid Python syntax
description: Python could not parse the source code.
solution: Check colons, brackets, quotes, commas, and the line immediately before the error.

pattern: TabError|inconsistent use of tabs and spaces
title: Mixed tabs and spaces
description: A block mixes tabs and spaces in a way Python cannot interpret consistently.
solution: Convert indentation to one consistent style, preferably four spaces.

title: Incompatible types
description: An operation or function call received a value of the wrong type.
solution: Inspect the runtime types and convert or guard values before the operation.

title: Local variable used before assignment
description: A function references a local variable before assigning it on the current path.
solution: Initialize the local variable or declare the intended outer scope explicitly.

title: Text decoding failed
description: Bytes could not be decoded with the selected character encoding.
solution: Use the source encoding, commonly UTF-8, or handle invalid bytes deliberately.

title: Text encoding failed
description: A string contains characters unsupported by the selected encoding.
solution: Use UTF-8 or configure an explicit error strategy such as replace.

title: Unicode operation failed
description: A text encoding, decoding, or translation operation failed.
solution: Verify the encoding and handle malformed or unsupported characters.

pattern: ValueError|invalid literal|too many values to unpack
title: Value has an invalid form
description: The type is acceptable, but the value cannot be used for this operation.
solution: Validate the value before conversion and handle invalid input.

title: Division by zero
description: A number was divided or moduloed by zero.
solution: Check the denominator before division and decide how an empty case should behave.

title: Lookup failed
description: A sequence or mapping lookup could not find the requested item.
solution: Validate the index or key and handle missing values explicitly.

title: Grouped exceptions need handling
description: Multiple exceptions were raised together and may need separate handling with except*.
solution: Handle each expected exception with except* clauses and preserve unexpected exceptions.

title: Operation would block
description: A non-blocking operation cannot complete immediately.
solution: Wait for readiness with selectors or retry only when the resource is ready.

title: Pipe or connection was closed
description: The program wrote to a pipe or socket whose reader had closed it.
solution: Handle the closed connection and stop writing when the peer disconnects.

title: Buffer operation failed
description: An operation could not be completed on a buffer object.
solution: Release active views, check buffer size, and avoid resizing while a view is exported.

title: Child process operation failed
description: An operation on a child process could not be completed.
solution: Check the child process lifecycle and handle already-reaped or invalid process IDs.

title: Connection was aborted
description: The local system aborted an active network connection.
solution: Handle the disconnect, close resources, and retry only when the operation is safe.

title: Network connection failed
description: A network connection operation failed and needs connection-specific handling.
solution: Check connectivity and endpoint health, close resources, and retry safe operations with a limit.

title: Connection was refused
description: The destination rejected the connection because no service accepted it or access was denied.
solution: Verify the host and port, start the service, and use bounded retries with backoff.

title: Connection was reset
description: The remote peer unexpectedly closed an active connection.
solution: Handle partial network work, close the socket, and retry idempotent operations when appropriate.

title: File already exists
description: An operation requiring a new path found that the path already exists.
solution: Use exist_ok=True when appropriate or check the path before creating it.

title: Floating-point operation failed
description: A floating-point operation raised an arithmetic exception.
solution: Validate numeric inputs and handle invalid, overflow, or underflow results explicitly.

title: System call was interrupted
description: An operating-system call was interrupted by a signal.
solution: Retry the operation when safe, or propagate cancellation and clean up resources.

title: A file was expected but a directory was found
description: A file-only operation received a directory path.
solution: Check the path type before opening and select a file inside the directory.

title: A directory was expected but a file was found
description: A path operation expected a directory component but found a file.
solution: Validate each path component and use the correct file or directory path.

title: Process was not found
description: The requested process does not exist or has already exited.
solution: Track process lifecycle state and handle processes that exit before the operation.

title: Operation timed out
description: An operation exceeded its configured time limit.
solution: Set a deliberate timeout, handle the timeout separately, and retry with a bounded backoff when safe.

title: Text translation failed
description: A Unicode translation operation could not process a character.
solution: Define a translation for the character or choose an explicit error policy.

title: Python runtime reported an internal error
description: The interpreter detected an internal problem or invalid extension behavior.
solution: Capture the full traceback, reduce the reproduction, and update or inspect native extensions.

title: Iterator has no more values
description: An iterator was exhausted, often inside a next() call.
solution: Provide a default to next() or catch StopIteration at the iterator boundary.

title: Async iterator has no more values
description: An asynchronous iterator was exhausted.
solution: Use async for or catch StopAsyncIteration at the async iterator boundary.

title: Program requested exit
description: The program or a library called exit and raised a termination exception.
solution: Return an exit code from the command boundary and avoid catching or raising it deep inside reusable code.

title: Execution was interrupted
description: The process received an interactive interrupt, commonly Ctrl+C.
solution: Clean up resources in finally blocks and allow graceful cancellation.

title: Grouped exceptions need handling
description: Several ordinary exceptions were raised together and may need separate handling with except*.
solution: Handle each expected exception with except* clauses and preserve unexpected exceptions.

title: Base exception caught too broadly
description: BaseException also catches system-exiting signals such as KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit.
solution: Catch the specific expected exception. If broad cleanup is required, perform it and re-raise the exception.

title: Generic exception handling hides failures
description: Catching Exception without handling known failure cases can conceal bugs and make recovery unclear.
solution: Catch specific exception types and handle or report them explicitly instead of silently continuing.

title: Generator is being closed
description: GeneratorExit is raised when a generator or coroutine is closed and should normally be allowed to propagate.
solution: Put cleanup in a finally block and do not suppress GeneratorExit unless the generator contract specifically requires it.

title: Python warning needs review
description: Warnings report questionable or changing behavior without necessarily stopping the program.
solution: Identify the specific warning category and fix its cause instead of globally suppressing warnings.

title: Application warning was raised
description: A library or application raised a general warning for a user-visible condition.
solution: Review the warning message and correct the underlying configuration or input condition.

title: Deprecated API is in use
description: The code uses behavior scheduled for removal or replacement.
solution: Migrate to the documented replacement API and test against the supported dependency version.

title: API may be deprecated in a future release
description: A dependency signals that an API may become deprecated in a future version.
example: warnings.warn('legacy option may be removed', PendingDeprecationWarning)
solution: Prefer the current documented API and check the library migration notes before upgrading.

title: Suspicious syntax detected
description: Python detected syntax that is valid but likely unintended or unsafe.
solution: Review the flagged expression and use the intended operator, such as == for value equality.

title: Runtime operation may be unsafe
description: A runtime operation produced a result or condition that deserves attention.
solution: Validate inputs and handle exceptional numeric or runtime states explicitly.

title: Dependency behavior will change
description: A dependency warns that current behavior will change in a future release.
solution: Update the code to the announced behavior and pin or test dependency versions during migration.

title: Import behavior may be incorrect
description: The import system or a package reports a questionable import configuration.
solution: Verify the module path, import hooks, optional dependency, and package configuration.

title: Unicode and byte data may be mixed
description: A text operation may be relying on an unsafe conversion between Unicode text and bytes.
solution: Choose an explicit encoding and decode bytes before applying text operations.

title: Bytes and text are being mixed
description: The code may be comparing or formatting bytes and text as though they were the same type.
example: warnings.warn('compare bytes and text explicitly', BytesWarning)
solution: Decode bytes with an explicit encoding or encode text before combining values.

title: Resource may not have been closed
description: A file, socket, or other resource may remain open after use.
solution: Use a context manager such as with open(...) so the resource closes on every exit path.

title: Text encoding was not specified
description: A text file operation relies on a platform-dependent default encoding.
solution: Specify encoding='utf-8' when opening text files to make behavior consistent across platforms.

title: Operation failed during Python shutdown
description: An operation such as starting a thread was attempted while the interpreter was finalizing.
solution: Start and stop worker threads before interpreter shutdown and release resources explicitly.

title: Potentially unsafe operation
description: This API can execute code, commands, or unsafe serialized data.
solution: Use safe parsers such as ast.literal_eval, avoid shell interpolation, and validate untrusted input.

title: Possible logic error
description: The code may run but its condition or control flow can produce an unintended result.
solution: Review the condition and add a terminating state, such as while queue: for a queue-processing loop.

title: Runtime execution timed out
description: The code did not finish within the smoke-test time limit.
solution: Check for an infinite loop, add a terminating condition, and reduce unnecessary work.
